name: Exp_BrakeExp
summary: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, which generates up/down momentum signals and trend states. It opens buy positions on up-signals and sell positions on down-signals, while closing opposite positions when the trend confirms against them. Position sizing uses a flexible MM parameter that supports either deposit-percentage or fixed-lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BrakeExp指标进行交易，该指标产生上/下动量信号和趋势状态。在上涨信号时开多仓，下跌信号时开空仓，并在趋势确认反向时平掉对冲仓位。仓位管理使用灵活的MM参数，支持按存款比例或固定手数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于BrakeExp自定义动量指标，该指标通过参数A和B计算价格动量变化来生成交易信号。入场条件为：当UpSignal触发时买入开仓，当DnSignal触发时卖出开仓，同时需要BuyPosOpen或SellPosOpen权限开启。出场条件为：当对向趋势确认时平仓（如UpTrend确认时平空头，DnTrend确认时平多头），同时设有固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例分配。资金管理方面，EA依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数处理开仓和平仓逻辑，包括价格偏差控制和信号时间戳验证。策略使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易，但缺少点差过滤和加仓限制机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the custom BrakeExp momentum indicator, which calculates price momentum changes using parameters A and B to generate trading signals. Entry conditions: buy when UpSignal triggers and sell when DnSignal triggers, provided the respective BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen permissions are enabled. Exit conditions: close opposite positions when the counter-trend is confirmed (e.g., close shorts when UpTrend is active, close longs when DnTrend is active), with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit percentage allocation. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for opening and closing positions, including price deviation control and signal timestamp validation. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades within the same bar, but lacks spread filtering and position accumulation limits.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 仓位比例，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot, negative=lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，信号和趋势分离处理，避免单一条件误判
提供买卖开关权限，可灵活控制交易方向
使用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可调，具备基本风控框架
MM参数支持比例和固定手数两种模式，资金管理灵活
pros_en: Clear strategy logic with separation of signal and trend states, reducing false triggers from single conditions
Provides buy/sell permission switches for flexible directional control
Uses new bar detection to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
Adjustable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk management framework
MM parameter supports both percentage-based and fixed lot sizing for flexible money management
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标BrakeExp和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少内置实现导致可移植性差
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等波动率自适应机制
没有最大持仓数量限制，可能在趋势反复中产生多次开仓
指标参数A和B缺乏说明文档，用户难以理解其含义和调优方向
cons_en: Depends on external custom BrakeExp indicator and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability and self-containedness
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without ATR-based volatility adaptation
No maximum position count limit, potentially generating multiple entries during whipsaw trends
Indicator parameters A and B lack documentation, making it difficult for users to understand and optimize them
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓
引入ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动率动态调整
增加最大同向持仓数量限制，防止趋势震荡中过度加仓
improvements_en: Add a spread filter condition to pause entries when spread exceeds a threshold
Introduce ATR-based adaptive stop loss and take profit that dynamically adjusts to market volatility
Add a maximum same-direction position count limit to prevent over-accumulation during choppy trends

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下滑点风险增大
没有最大持仓限制，趋势反复时可能多次开仓导致过度敞口
固定止损1000点与止盈2000点的2:1比例可能在低波动市场中止损过宽
risk_points_en: No spread filter increases slippage risk in high-spread environments
No maximum position limit may lead to over-exposure during trend reversals and whipsaws
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP with 2:1 ratio may result in excessively wide stops in low-volatility markets
